Ordinance be amended by changing all the RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and

Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-G in the area

bounded by


        West 87'^ Street; a line 188 feet east of and parallel to South Elizabeth Street;

        Street,


to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

and due publication.
